Cc: contracts@nebula.io, procurement@nebula.io
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood MSA + Order Form — kickoff and template mapping

Hi Michael —

Thanks for the intro last week. Attaching Nebula's MSA (v1) and a draft order form. We'd like to kick off a quick mapping exercise so your legal/ops team can confirm any material deviations from your standard MSA + order form template before we circulate redlines.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm which sections you consider immutable for our pricing cadence and data residency (we flagged Section 4 and 8 in the attached PDF).
- Share your preferred Exhibit A / SOW fields so we can populate the OrderForm_Excel with the right line items and billing contacts.
- A rough timeline for legal review — Nebula needs procurement sign-off by May 18 to hit our FY quarter close.

I've attached Nebula_MSA_v1.pdf and OrderForm_Nebula.xlsx for reference. Happy to jump on a 30-min sync this week if that's easier.

Thanks,
Samir Shah
Head of Procurement
Nebula Analytics

Samir —

Appreciate the materials. Looping in Karthik (Contracts), Laura (Billing & Orderforms), and Monica (Legal intake) to do an initial pass. Quick responses inline:

- Immutable sections: we'll need Legal to confirm but our standard stance is that pricing cadence is set in the Order Form; Section 4 (Pricing/Charges) is usually driven by the Order Form rather than the MSA. Section 8 (Data residency) can be scoped as an SLA Exhibit when customers require specific regions.

- Exhibit A / Order form fields: Laura, can you confirm the exact column names you need in the Excel so we can return a populated copy?

- Timeline: Monica — can your team deliver a redline summary by EOD May 7? Nebula's May 18 procurement deadline is tight but looks feasible if we prioritize.

Proposed next steps:
1) Laura to provide mapping template (column names) — due 5/5
2) Contracts/Legal to provide high-level redline flags and whether any terms require escalation — due 5/7
3) Quick sync (15–30m) if Nebula wants to walk through flags — target 5/6 or 5/7

I'll attach a short notes file with internal pointers.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: michael_grant@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — kickoff and template mapping

Thanks Michael — Laura here. Samir / Nebula team: below are the exact column headers we need to ingest the Order Form into our billing system. If you can return the attached Excel with these columns filled, that will speed up setup.

Required columns for OrderForm_Nebula.xlsx:
- Customer Legal Name
- Redwood Account ID (leave blank if unknown)
- Billing Contact Name
- Billing Contact Email
- Billing Address (line1, line2, city, state, postal)
- Purchase Order # (optional)
- Product SKU
- Quantity (units/month)
- Term Start Date
- Term End Date
- Monthly Recurring Charge (USD)
- One-time Setup Fee (USD)
- Payment Terms (Net 30 / Net 45)
- Currency

Other notes:
- For pricing cadence: if Nebula wants quarterly step-ups, include separate line items per pricing period (we prefer solid line items rather than ambiguous schedule text).
- On data residency: Monica, if we need an Exhibit, flag the specific regions; otherwise we can handle via a short clause in the SLR.

I'll provide a cleaned mapping template by EOD 5/5.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Billing Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Samir Shah <samir@nebula.io>, michael_grant@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 06 May 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — kickoff and template mapping

Hi Samir — thanks for sharing the MSA and order form. Quick legal intake summary and next steps below.

Intake summary:
- High-level: Nebula MSA v1 contains a few non-standard liability caps and audit notice windows that our standard MSA does not accept as-is.
- Section calls: Section 9 (Indemnity) — minor carve requested; Section 12 (Limitation of Liability) — cap language appears to be higher risk (we propose cap = greater of $1M or 3x fees in first 12 months).
- Data residency: Nebula has a callout for EU residency in Section 8; if you need specific regions, we'll propose an Exhibit (timeline to produce: 48 hours after Nebula confirms regions).

Requested inputs from Nebula:
- Confirm preferred liability cap or whether you want to propose a reciprocal cap.
- Confirm which Redwood contacts should receive SOC2 / pen-test evidence (we typically list Security@nebula.io or an audit alias).

Proposed timelines:
- Our high-level redline summary (one-pager) by EOD 5/7
- Full redline document for commenting by 5/12

If Nebula is fine with those timelines I'll prepare the one-pager and share via the Drive link. If you want us to accept any of your MSA language verbatim, call it out in your reply so Contracts can track exceptions.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
